The Pledge of Allegiance

I pledge allegiance to the Flag of the United States of America, and to the Republic for which it stands, one Nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.

Pledge wording

The U.S. pledge follows 4 U.S.C. § 4. The New Mexico salute follows the New Mexico Public Education Commission: “the Zia symbol,” without an added “and.” Flag design reference: New Mexico Secretary of State.

Song lyrics

“The Star-Spangled Banner”: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and Smithsonian National Museum of American History. “O Fair New Mexico”: Elizabeth Garrett’s 1915 sheet music, provided by the New Mexico Secretary of State. The original wording and Spanish place-name spelling are preserved; line breaks are arranged for classroom reading.
